html:
Greetings, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.!

MARVEL Future Fight has been updated to give you a better experience
and we would like to share the news with you!
 
Newly introduced special gear is awaiting you!
We are also happy to inform you about the new Limited Exclusive Item Notification function,
multiple system improvements and various improvements for different heroes.

Please check below for more details!
 
▣ Special gear
 
ISO-8 and gear window placement has been swapped.
To the right side from the basic gear you will be able to see special gear.


※ You can put on the special gear when you reach level 30.
※ You cannot upgrade special gear.
 
Special gear includes Resist Devices that have resistance effect against different conditions, Boosters and Generators that reinforce your defense or specific attack power. Each item has a unique effect that will make your hero stronger.

 
Special gear can be found in Dimension Rifts, each Dimension Rift will allow you to acquire unique special gear.

- Although this gear is called 'Special' it doesn't mean that you can get it from Special missions. It can be found in Dimension Rifts!

※ The higher the grade of the stage you cleared the more powerful special gear you will be able to get.

Once you equip special gear you won't be able to return to the previous state. If you change it to other special equipment option, the previous one will vanish.  

- Special gear can be changed but cannot be unequipped so please think carefully!

#Note
- Currently there is an issue with Special Gear that forcefully restarts the game in some cases. This will be fixed as fast as possible. 

▣ Added Notifications of Limited Exclusive Items changing in the shop

During the game you will see notifications about the changing of rotation items (Limited Exclusive Items) in the shop.
-Now you will be able to know about the change of the limited items without checking the shop.
 
The notification will be shown on the top of the idle game screen, mission preparation screen and even during the stage.
※ The notification will not be shown on the launch screen.
 
▣ Changing Gear Option Retry added
 
A new button that allows you to retry gear option change was added to the New Option window.

- When you press this button the option will be immediately changed without an additional confirmation. If you don't want to retry, be sure to press [OK] button!
 
※We won't be able to assist you on the matters concerning the options that have been changed.
 
▣ Icons for the items acquired during the stage added
 
Items acquired during the current stage will now be shown on the top of the screen.


- Now you can check what you got during the mission straight away!
 
 
▣ Other game improvements/corrections
 
[Hero improvements]
1. Incorrect functioning of some skills was fixed and made more effective.
 - Applies to the following skills: Elektra (Heavy Sais), Mockingbird (Bo-Staff Kick), Black Panther (Claw Slash), Ultron (Robotic Slam)
Hulkbuster (Hydraulic Boom), Ultron MK-3 (Encephalo-Ray), Vision (Density Shift)
2. Range of some skills was improved so that heroes could hit the target more accurately.
- Applies to the following skills: Vision (Density Shift), Yondu (Arrow Call), Luke Cage (Street Style)
3. Speed improvement for selected heroes.
 - Rocket Raccoon's moving speed was improved.
 - Star-Lord's normal attack and 'I have a Plan' skill speed was improved.
 - The delay after Hulkbuster's 'Repulsor Smash' and 'Hydraulic Boom' skills was shortened.
4. The issue with abnormally low damage dealt by Black Bolt's 'Electron Channeling' skill was resolved.
5. The issue with Yondu's 'Arrow Call' and 'Ravager Strike' skills sporadically not working in certain environments was resolved.
6. During Joint attack Thor's appearance position and time was corrected so that he could hit the target better with his skill.
7. Issue with Vision's 'Solar Energy Beam' skill that does not target the next enemy has been resolved.
8. The impact of Thor's 'Call the Lightning' skill is now shown more accurately to the moment of use.
 
[Bug fixes and game improvements]
1. The issue with the incorrect functioning of the On/Off settings of 'Auto Attack after Skill Use' was resolved. It will be active only if the PAD controls mode is chosen.
2. In certain cases the Dimension Shifters Biometrics showing in the Clear rewards was resolved.
3. The issue with some of the Guardians of the Galaxy characters' skills produced sound even on mute has been resolved
4. The issue with Joint attack skills not working in certain situations was fixed.
5. The issue with heroes braking through barriers in certain situations was resolved.  
6. Mission clear rewards such as acquired items and Exp can now be viewed even more conveniently.
7. Issues with an Energy Field does not disappear in certain cases has been resolved.
8. Library icon was changed.
9. The team leader will be placed in the middle during the preparation.
10. The issue with the absence of a sound effect when a Clear ticket is used was fixed.
11. Sound effect was added when Dimension Shifters arrive.
12. Pop-up window added when using the 'No Limit' option in Special Missions.
